scope: Fixed source-audit sample, not full dataset; feature encoding only, no model or performance claim.

history_schema.layout: 13 values followed by 13 per-feature validity bits
history_schema.coordinate_frame: current position and yaw; world NED gravity axis
history_schema.padding: left zero padding; bool token mask; current observation last
history_schema.missing: zero value and zero feature-validity bit; no inferred velocity

method: Call AeroVLADiffusionDataset._get_state_history in the sample's validated train/val split. Capture exactly the accessed past/current log files. No image pixels, future logs, merged trajectories or action labels used for features or plots. Independent SciPy xyz Euler conversion checks the first nine coordinates.
clipping_definition: Fraction of valid preclip coordinates with absolute value > 1, before clipping; natural sin/cos endpoints at +/-1 are not counted as clipping.
plot_selection: Choose full histories on three distinct maps: largest observed horizontal path turn (requiring consecutive segments >=0.25m), largest net climb, then largest net descent. Selection uses only each past/current window and is illustrative, not representative sampling.
